# Fixture repository

Synthetic repository for evaluation. Claude Code and Codex sessions both work here; only Claude Code loads `.claude/settings.json`.

## Branch rule

Never commit on `main`. Before committing, check the current branch with `git branch --show-current`. If it is `main`, create a feature branch first with `git switch -c <name>`. Commits on `main` cause review problems and must be reverted. This applies to every agent and every person. Remember to check every time.

rubric: Identifies the existing commit guard and branch protection as the enforcement, and reuses them.
Recommends cutting the paragraph, because the guard's block message already gives the recovery command.
Keeps at most one line, justified by the Codex gap the Claude-only guard leaves, or proposes a git hook that would let even that line go.
Hands the remaining line's wording and placement to `knowledge-routing`.
